iWantTo: see a scannable table of stock by location on the home screen
soThat: I can quickly survey what is on each shelf

independence.rationale: S1 delivers the write+read API and form submit; S2 delivers the home-screen table view — a distinct read surface with layout, right-aligned quantities, and an explicit empty-location state. Building S1 fully leaves the home-screen table entirely unbuilt.
